name: serenity-data-bridge
description: Read-only A-share and US-equity data tools for evidence-backed Serenity-style research.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex and compatible agents to A-share and US-equity prices, fundamentals, financial statements, news, and ownership activity through a local MCP server, with additional sector and market signals for A shares.
defaultPrompt: Research an A-share company using current market and filing data.
Check the fundamentals, news, and risk signals for an A-share ticker.
Analyze NVDA using current price, fundamentals, filings, news, and insider data.
